reference_format.note: On this register (Eden and South Lakeland areas): YYYY/NNNN/TYPE, with the reference in path form on the detail page (/Planning/Display/2026/1846/TCA). Barrow-area applications carry B<NN>/YYYY/NNNN references (e.g. B21/2026/0359) on a different system.

browser_route.note: Reference with its slashes. For the Barrow area use https://webapps.barrowbc.gov.uk/webapps/f?p=BARROWPLANNINGHUB:APPLICATIONSEARCH:0.

quirks.summary: This register covers only the Eden and South Lakeland areas; Barrow-area applications are on the former Barrow council's Planning Hub.
quirks.detail: The council's 'Search for a planning application' page (checked 2026-09-26) sends Barrow-area searches to https://webapps.barrowbc.gov.uk/webapps/f?p=BARROWPLANNINGHUB:APPLICATIONSEARCH (see barrow-in-furness-borough-council; it shows only the last seven years) and Eden and South Lakeland to this register (1988 onwards). PlanIt still files Barrow cases under a separate 'Barrow' area with that source URL (e.g. B21/2026/0359, validated September 2026). Minerals and waste applications are on the former county register (see cumbria-county-council). National park sites go to the Lake District or Yorkshire Dales national park authorities.
quirks.workaround: Route B<NN>/... references to the Barrow Planning Hub. A search here for a Barrow reference finds nothing, which is not evidence it does not exist.

quirks.summary: Document links are rendered as data-disabled-link attributes (enabled client-side after a copyright tick-box), not href, so a grep for href="/Document/Download finds nothing.
quirks.detail: Each row also carries a checkbox with data-record, data-planid, data-imageid and data-filename. The URL in data-disabled-link downloaded normally with a plain GET; no copyright-agreement request was needed.
quirks.workaround: Grep /Document/Download?[^"]* in any attribute, un-escape &, and count rows by data-filename.

pacing.note: Five requests to the register host at 5 s spacing on 2026-09-26 with no 429 or challenge.

robots.note: No robots.txt on the register host (404).

endpoints.note: No disclaimer gate was met on this install; the detail page loaded directly.

verification.note: PlanIt's areas record gave the register; fingerprinted as classic DEF Atrium. Reference 2026/1846/TCA (Grange-over-Sands) from PlanIt's applics records -> /Planning/Display/2026/1846/TCA with 5 document rows (PlanIt n_documents 5), links in data-disabled-link -> GET /Document/Download for the application form: application/pdf, %PDF-1.4, 234,279 bytes, 6 pages with extractable text, no rate-limit, permission or unavailable notice. The council's search page was read for area routing (Barrow on the legacy Planning Hub). Modern.gov GetCommittees checked for committee ids.
